note: Under VISN 10 — Great Lakes. 'VA Medical Centers' is not a body the VA names; it is this graph's collective heading, carried identically as a child of every VISN, standing in for the individual medical centres a network actually contains — each of which has its own name and facility page. The node's own description says as much ('Each VISN contains multiple VAMCs. Structure per VAMC: Director, Chief of Staff, ...'), and its 26 children are the same template of posts under both copies. Read three VA pages against it rather than guessing — https://www.va.gov/health (9,441 readable chars), https://www.va.gov/ (2,130) and https://department.va.gov/integrated-service-networks/ (1,722) — and none labels 'VA Medical Centers'.
